title: Kirby Problem 4.122
exact_target: Can one fixed surface in the four-sphere serve as the branch locus for every closed orientable smooth four-manifold? Also seek connected universal surfaces in the four-ball and characterize which universal three-dimensional links bound universal surfaces.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 2998 (KP-4.122). CC BY 4.0.

R. İnanç Baykur, Robion C. Kirby and Daniel Ruberman (eds.), \emph{K3: A New Problem List in Low-Dimensional Topology}, AMS Mathematical Surveys and Monographs 295 (2026), author preliminary edition. Problem4.122 and all four remarks, pages291--292.

Riccardo Piergallini and Daniele Zuddas, \emph{A universal ribbon surface in $B^4$}, arXiv:math/0308222v1 (2003); Proceedings of the London Mathematical Society90 (2005),763--782. Introduction, page2 definitions, Section4 Questions2 and4.
